def factor_overnight_intraday_ewm_reversal(df):
    """Linear combination of EWMA-smoothed overnight and intraday returns for reversal and momentum."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_price = df_copy["open"]
    
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(close, open_price)
    
    span = 20
    smooth_overnight = overnight_ret.ewm(span=span, min_periods=10).mean()
    smooth_intraday = intraday_ret.ewm(span=span, min_periods=10).mean()
    
    signal = -smooth_overnight + smooth_intraday
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_ewm_reversal"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_ewm_reversal"]
description: EWMA smoothing replaces simple rolling mean to give more weight to recent observations, improving timeliness of the reversal/momentum signals while preserving the parent's decomposition-based linear combination.
